description: Search the manual by your own words. Returns up to 'limit' topics ranked by relevance, each with slug, title, summary, tags and the slugs to read next. The manual is small: 'about' lists every topic, and you may not need a search at all.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits, 1 to 20, default 5.

query.description: What you want to know, as words or a question.

name: search_library

hits.description: The topics that match, best first.

see_also.description: Slugs of the topics to read next.

slug.description: The stable identifier of the topic; pass it to read_topic.

summary.description: One or two sentences that answer the question the title asks.

tags.description: Keywords; the first names the group of the topic.

note.description: Empty when there are hits. Otherwise what to do instead.

topics_in_manual.description: How many topics the manual has in all.

title: Search the manual
